title: Information Transparency of Firm Financing
title_zh: 企业融资信息透明度
title_primary: 企业融资信息透明度
title_secondary: Information Transparency of Firm Financing
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We propose a theory on information transparency of optimal financial contracts. Our model nests adverse selection and agency cost. There exists a unique perfect Bayesian equilibrium with novel features: First, three types of optimal contracts can arise endogenously, that is, equity, transparent debt, and opaque debt. The former two require firms to take on a costly verification technology while opaque debt does not. Second, the unique equilibrium is either pooling on opaque debt, or mixing with transparent and opaque financing. Third, firms with sufficiently high quality and intermediate levels of internal funds find it optimal to use a transparent contract.
abstract_zh: 我们提出关于最优金融合约信息透明度的理论。该模型嵌套了逆向选择与代理成本。存在一个具有新颖特征的唯一完美贝叶斯均衡：首先，三种类型的最优合约可内生产生，即股权、透明债务与不透明债务。前两者要求企业采用成本高昂的验证技术，而不透明债务则无需如此。其次，该唯一均衡要么是全部采用不透明债务的混同均衡，要么是透明融资与不透明融资混合的均衡。第三，具有足够高质量和中等内部资金水平的企业发现使用透明合约是最优选择。

title: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
title_zh: 天气冲击的区域经济影响：来自葡萄牙的证据
title_primary: 天气冲击的区域经济影响：来自葡萄牙的证据
title_secondary: The regional economic impact of weather shocks: Evidence from Portugal
authors: Drabindra Pandit, Paulo Rodrigues, João Seixo
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Weather extremes shape short-run economic activity through both market and nonmarket channels, yet evidence on local consumer-side activity remains limited. Using a municipality-level panel of Portuguese data (2010–2021), we estimate panel VAR and local-projection responses to weather shocks of point-of-sale purchases (a measure of merchant-location transaction activity, not resident household consumption), together with unemployment and house prices. Our central methodological finding is that hourly rather than daily measurement of rainfall variability raises the estimated semi-elasticities by an order of magnitude, suggesting that the existing climate-economy literature systematically understates the importance of high-intensity rainfall. Substantively, the local-projection responses indicate that hourly rainfall volatility raises purchases on impact and reverses the following quarter, consistent with intertemporal reallocation; temperature variability generates a sharp positive impact effect followed by a contraction; and high fire-danger days raise contemporaneous purchases. Unemployment and house prices follow the same patterns more weakly. Regional heterogeneity is substantial, the Lisbon Metropolitan Area and the Algarve sometimes display effects opposite in sign to those in the North.
abstract_zh: 极端天气通过市场与非市场渠道影响短期经济活动，但关于本地消费者侧活动的证据仍然有限。基于葡萄牙市级面板数据（2010-2021年），我们采用面板VAR和局部投影法估计了天气冲击对销售点购买行为（衡量商户所在地交易活动，而非居民家庭消费）、失业率和房价的影响。核心方法论发现是：以小时而非日度频率测量降雨变异性，会使估计的半弹性系数提升一个数量级，表明现有气候经济学文献系统性低估了高强度降雨的重要性。从实质结果看，局部投影响应显示：小时降雨波动性在当期推高购买量，随后一个季度出现反转，符合跨期重新配置特征；温度波动性产生先急剧正向冲击后收缩的效应；高火灾风险日则提升同期购买量。失业率和房价呈现相同但更弱的模式。区域异质性显著，里斯本大都市区和阿尔加维地区有时呈现与北部地区符号相反的效应。

title: Motivating Job Seekers. A Field Experiment
title_zh: 激励求职者：一项田野实验
title_primary: 激励求职者：一项田野实验
title_secondary: Motivating Job Seekers. A Field Experiment
authors: Cockx, Bart, Egebark, Johan, Van Hoye, Greet, Videnord, Emilie, Vikström, Johan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Reduced motivation over the unemployment spell may contribute to declining job-finding rates. We report findings from a low-cost digital intervention that uses motivational emails to enhance job seekers
abstract_zh: 失业期间动机的减弱可能导致求职成功率下降。我们报告了一项低成本数字干预措施的研究结果，该措施通过发送激励性电子邮件来提升求职者的积极性。

title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
title_zh: 组织中的人才囤积现象
title_primary: 组织中的人才囤积现象
title_secondary: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm.
abstract_zh: 大多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，那些以团队绩效为考核标准的管理者，有动机囤积人才。本研究首次利用一家大型企业的人事档案和调查证据，提供了人才囤积的实证依据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，这一现象在管理者对员工才能的评分中可被察觉，并且在囤积动机更强时（以绩效薪酬、团队规模和人才可见度为衡量指标）更为频繁。通过准随机暴露于人才囤积情境，本研究表明，囤积行为会抑制内部工作申请，阻碍职业发展，并改变企业内的人才配置。

title: How Does Monetary and Fiscal Policy Affect the Economy in the Face of Large Shocks?
title_zh: 货币与财政政策如何应对大规模冲击下的经济影响？
title_primary: 货币与财政政策如何应对大规模冲击下的经济影响？
title_secondary: How Does Monetary and Fiscal Policy Affect the Economy in the Face of Large Shocks?
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We build a model that combines (i) heterogeneous households with incomplete markets, and (ii) state-dependent pricing with strategic complementarities by firms, to analyze the effects of large macroeconomic shocks and policy interventions. Both features significantly influence the transmission of fiscal stimulus and monetary policy—heterogeneous households because of failures of Ricardian equivalence, and state-dependent pricing because of its nonlinear effects on inflation. We use our model to quantify how monetary and fiscal policy shaped macroeconomic dynamics in response to the large shocks of 2020, and how alternative policy choices could have led to different aggregate and distributional outcomes. We find large departures from Ricardian equivalence and strong stepping-on-a-rake effects of interest rate changes. The large unfunded fiscal transfer program helped prevent deflation in 2020 and significantly raised output throughout 2021 and 2022, but led to permanently higher prices. The monetary easing through 2020 and 2021 also contributed to preventing deflation, but had a minimal impact on GDP. The monetary tightening from 2022 lowered the maximum inflation rate, but contributed to persistently above-trend inflation. These policies led to net welfare gains for low-wealth households and net welfare losses for high-wealth households, but those welfare effects are due to incomplete markets for idiosyncratic risk not aggregate stabilization. Alternative commitments to funding fiscal stimulus could have achieved similar short-term effects on inflation and output with a much smaller long-term increase in the price level.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结合（i）异质性家庭与不完全市场，以及（ii）企业具有战略互补性的状态依存定价的模型，以分析大规模宏观经济冲击与政策干预的影响。这两个特征均显著影响财政刺激与货币政策的传导机制——异质性家庭因李嘉图等价失效，而状态依存定价则因其对通胀的非线性效应。我们利用该模型量化了2020年大规模冲击下货币与财政政策如何塑造宏观经济动态，并探讨了替代性政策选择可能导致的总体与分配结果差异。研究发现，李嘉图等价存在显著偏离，且利率变动具有强烈的“踩耙子效应”。大规模无资金支持的财政转移计划虽有助于防止2020年通缩，并在2021至2022年间显著提升产出，但导致价格永久性上升。2020至2021年的货币宽松政策同样有助于防止通缩，但对GDP影响甚微。2022年起的货币紧缩政策降低了通胀峰值，却导致通胀持续高于趋势水平。这些政策使低财富家庭获得净福利收益，而高财富家庭则承受净福利损失，但此类福利效应源于异质性风险的不完全市场，而非总需求稳定。若采用替代性财政刺激资金承诺，可在实现类似短期通胀与产出效果的同时，大幅降低长期价格水平的上升幅度。

title: The Political Economy of Foreign Exchange Interventions
title_zh: 外汇干预的政治经济学
title_primary: 外汇干预的政治经济学
title_secondary: The Political Economy of Foreign Exchange Interventions
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Exchange rate movements have implications for the purchasing power of residents or voters. Given that the exchange rate is often seen as a barometer of government performance, there could be strong incentives to influence exchange rate valuation during elections. This paper investigates whether political economy factors affect Foreign Exchange Intervention (FXI) policy across countries. It investigates whether central banks tend to implement FX sales, leaning against depreciations, during electoral periods in a sample of 28 countries including both advanced (AEs) and emerging (EMs) economies over the period 2000-2019. The results show that EMs with competitive elections tend to implement more and larger FX sales in pre-electoral period, compared to post-election period, given their political popularity. Further, this result is driven by countries where political pressures on central bank governors are more prevalent. Furthermore, the paper also finds that monetary policy transparency has the potential to mitigate this politically driven FXI during electoral period. Finally, the paper discusses policy implications given that politically motivated FX sales could hamper the ability of central banks to effectively respond to large shocks.
abstract_zh: 汇率变动对居民或选民的购买力具有重要影响。鉴于汇率常被视为政府绩效的晴雨表，选举期间可能存在强烈动机干预汇率估值。本文研究政治经济因素是否会影响各国的外汇干预政策，基于2000-2019年涵盖28个经济体（包括发达经济体和新兴经济体）的样本，考察央行是否倾向于在选举期间实施外汇抛售以应对本币贬值压力。结果表明，具有竞争性选举的新兴经济体在选举前阶段，出于政治声望考量，会实施更多且规模更大的外汇抛售。进一步分析显示，这一结果在央行行长面临更普遍政治压力的国家尤为显著。此外，本文还发现货币政策透明度具有缓解选举期间政治驱动型外汇干预的潜力。最后，本文讨论了政策启示：出于政治动机的外汇抛售可能削弱央行有效应对重大冲击的能力。

title: Long-term Effects of US Tariff Increases on CAPDR
title_zh: 美国关税上调对中美洲、巴拿马和多米尼加共和国（CAPDR）的长期影响
title_primary: 美国关税上调对中美洲、巴拿马和多米尼加共和国（CAPDR）的长期影响
title_secondary: Long-term Effects of US Tariff Increases on CAPDR
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In a series of declarations throughout 2025 and into 2026, the United States announced higher tariffs on nearly all imports from most countries. The countries that make up the CAPDR region (Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama and El Salvador) are affected through sizeable direct trade linkages with the United States, and through indirect trade linkages with third countries. This paper explores the potential long-term economic effects of these tariff increases on CAPDR using a multi-region multi-industry model of the global economy. The modelling exercises suggest that CAPDR member countries will experience falls in real GDP to varying degrees, with the severity of the effect closely linked to direct export exposure to the United States. The most vulnerable industries are heavily trade-exposed manufactures, although exemptions – most importantly for textiles & apparel – may provide some scope for trade diversion to offset some of the GDP losses. Although ongoing legal challenges have introduced additional uncertainty regarding the ultimate extent of tariff changes, the results in this paper will remain broadly valid providing the tariffs remain in place.
abstract_zh: 在2025年至2026年的一系列声明中，美国宣布对来自大多数国家的几乎所有进口商品加征更高关税。中美洲-多米尼加共和国地区（CAPDR）成员国（哥斯达黎加、多米尼加共和国、危地马拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、巴拿马和萨尔瓦多）通过与美国直接且规模可观的贸易联系，以及与第三国的间接贸易联系而受到影响。本文运用全球经济多区域多产业模型，探讨了这些关税上调对CAPDR的潜在长期经济影响。模型测算表明，CAPDR成员国实际GDP将出现不同程度的下降，其影响严重程度与对美国的直接出口敞口密切相关。最脆弱的行业是高度依赖贸易的制造业，尽管豁免条款——最重要的是纺织品与服装——可能通过贸易转移在一定程度上抵消部分GDP损失。尽管持续的法律挑战为关税变动的最终幅度增添了额外不确定性，但只要关税措施持续实施，本文的研究结果将基本保持有效。

title: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
title_zh: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究
title_primary: 作物多样性与农业面积在农业生态系统服务中的相互作用：基于地方水质的分析与实证研究
title_secondary: Interplay of crop diversity and agricultural area in agroecosystem services: Analytical and empirical study on local water quality
authors: Yunsun Park, Seong D. Yun, Matthew G. Interis, T. Edward Yu
abstract: This study expands the framework for analyzing the interplay of agricultural area and crop diversity on agroecosystem services by incorporating the species‐area relationship concept from biology. We estimate panel fixed effects models that include both agricultural area and crop diversity, along with their interaction term. This approach allows us to derive a crop diversity threshold‐the point at which agricultural land no longer exerts a negative marginal effect on water quality, driven by adjustments along the intensive margin rather than the extensive margin. By replicating well‐established water quality models from the literature and conducting robustness checks, we validate this framework. Our results empirically demonstrate that crop diversity can mitigate the adverse impact of agricultural land on water quality, aligning with the goals of conservation programs. This framework provides a more comprehensive understanding of agriculture's non‐unidirectional contributions to water quality, rather than only negative impacts, which are pervasive in the literature. Moreover, the thresholds identified in this study provide valuable insights for prioritizing regions for landscape‐based, crop diversity‐driven conservation strategies and policy design.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过引入生物学中的物种-面积关系概念，拓展了分析农业面积与作物多样性对农业生态系统服务交互作用的框架。我们估计了包含农业面积、作物多样性及其交互项的面板固定效应模型。这一方法使我们能够推导出作物多样性阈值——即农业用地通过集约边际调整而非粗放边际调整，不再对水质产生负面边际效应的临界点。通过复现文献中成熟的水质模型并进行稳健性检验，我们验证了这一框架的有效性。实证结果表明，作物多样性能够缓解农业用地对水质的负面影响，这与保护项目的目标一致。该框架有助于更全面地理解农业对水质的非单向贡献（而非文献中普遍强调的单一负面影响）。此外，本研究识别的阈值可为优先区域划定提供依据，助力基于景观格局、以作物多样性为导向的保护策略与政策设计。

title: Socioeconomic Inequalities in Birth Weight: Novel Distributional Evidence from Linked Population Data
title_zh: 出生体重的社会经济不平等：来自关联人口数据的新分布证据
title_primary: 出生体重的社会经济不平等：来自关联人口数据的新分布证据
title_secondary: Socioeconomic Inequalities in Birth Weight: Novel Distributional Evidence from Linked Population Data
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study is the first to use population-wide birth registration data spanning 18 years, linked to Census records, to examine the relationship between a comprehensive set of socioeconomic factors and the birth weight of more than 1.2 million children in Australia, both at the mean and across the distribution. Employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother fixed-effects models, the study reports five main findings, several of which offer new insights for the literature. First, both maternal and paternal education are positively associated with children's birth weight, with stronger associations observed for maternal education and at the lower end of the birth weight distribution. Second, parental income exhibits a positive but non-linear association with birth weight, with larger effects among lower-birth-weight children. Third, relative to children living in rental housing, those born into families with mortgaged homes have higher average birth weights, whereas those born into families that own their homes outright have lower average birth weights. However, children from home-owning families exhibit higher birth weights at the lower end of the distribution but lower birth weights at the upper end. Fourth, more favourable local socioeconomic conditions are positively but non-linearly associated with birth weight, with stronger associations at the lower end of the distribution. Fifth, children born to mothers who migrated from low- or middle-income countries have lower birth weights than those born to mothers from high-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次利用覆盖18年的人口出生登记数据，并结合人口普查记录，考察了澳大利亚超过120万儿童出生体重与一系列社会经济因素在均值及分布层面的关联。通过采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型），研究得出五项主要发现，其中多项为现有文献提供了新见解。第一，母亲与父亲的教育水平均与儿童出生体重呈正相关，其中母亲教育的关联性更强，且在出生体重分布的低端更为显著。第二，父母收入与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，对低出生体重儿童的影响更大。第三，相较于居住在租赁住房中的儿童，出生于有抵押贷款家庭的儿童平均出生体重更高，而出生于完全自有住房家庭的儿童平均出生体重更低。然而，来自完全自有住房家庭的儿童在出生体重分布低端呈现更高体重，但在高端则呈现更低体重。第四，更有利的本地社会经济条件与出生体重呈正向但非线性的关联，且在分布低端关联性更强。第五，出生于来自中低收入国家母亲的儿童，其出生体重低于出生于来自高收入国家母亲的儿童。

title: Ex-ante moral hazard? Overweight and health insurance expansion in Mexico
title_zh: 事前道德风险？墨西哥的超重与健康保险扩展
title_primary: 事前道德风险？墨西哥的超重与健康保险扩展
title_secondary: Ex-ante moral hazard? Overweight and health insurance expansion in Mexico
authors: Costa-Font, Joan, Györi, Mario, Saenz De Miera, Belen
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Extending health insurance coverage to previously uninsured populations can improve access to preventive services by relaxing financial barriers to health information and care, including those related to weight management. However, in the presence of ex-ante moral hazard, insurance coverage may weaken incentives for preventive effort, potentially increasing unhealthy behaviours. This paper examines this phenomenon using evidence from the introduction of a universal public insurance program, namely Mexico’s Seguro Popular (SP), in the 2000s. We exploit plausibly exogenous variation in the rollout of SP across municipalities generated by differential implementation speeds. We find no evidence that the rollout of SP modified individuals’ body mass index (BMI) or obesity status. Further, heterogeneity analysis suggests that SP exposure leads to a significant reduction in BMI among individuals who were already overweight at baseline, and a 2 percentage point decline in smoking prevalence, consistent with the hypothesis that SP increased access to preventative health information. These results suggest no evidence of ex-ante moral hazard in weight-related health behaviours after the expansion of universal insurance.
abstract_zh: 将医疗保险覆盖范围扩展至此前未参保人群，可通过减轻获取健康信息与医疗服务（包括体重管理相关服务）的经济障碍，提升预防性服务的可及性。然而，在存在事前道德风险的情况下，保险覆盖可能削弱个体采取预防性行为的激励，从而增加不健康行为。本文利用21世纪初墨西哥实施全民公共医疗保险计划（即大众保险）的证据，研究这一现象。我们借助各城市因执行速度差异导致的大众保险推广进程中的外生变异，发现该保险推广并未改变个体的身体质量指数或肥胖状况。进一步异质性分析表明，大众保险的覆盖导致基线超重人群的身体质量指数显著下降，并使吸烟率降低2个百分点，这与保险覆盖增加了预防性健康信息可及性的假说一致。这些结果表明，在全民保险扩展后，体重相关健康行为中并未出现事前道德风险的证据。

authors: Marion Mercier, Arthur Silve, Benjamin Tremblay-Auger
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: States sometimes back rebellions abroad to signal resolve. We study this reputation-building logic in international relations, focusing on co-ethnic links between countries as an objective source of variation in a state‚s incentives to demonstrate resolve. We formally derive two interconnected predictions from the mechanism: (a) a state is more likely to endorse the uprising of a foreign group when facing a larger audience, resulting in (b) greater political inclusion for the group. We build a comprehensive panel dataset of co-ethnic rebellion sponsorship, and find evidence consistent with both predictions.
abstract_zh: 国家有时会支持国外的叛乱以展示其决心。我们研究国际关系中的这种声誉构建逻辑，重点关注国家间基于同族裔联系这一客观因素，如何影响国家展示决心的动机。我们通过形式化推导得出两个相互关联的预测：（a）当面对更广泛的受众时，国家更可能支持外国群体的起义，从而（b）该群体获得更大的政治包容性。我们构建了关于同族裔叛乱赞助的全面面板数据集，并发现了与这两个预测一致的证据。

abstract: In a coordination game with multiple Pareto ordered equilibria and population uncertainty, we show that group size helps select a unique equilibrium, for reasons reminiscent of the global games literature. A critical mass phenomenon emerges at equilibrium. Group size has an emboldening effect on participants.
